commits.message:
perf: optimize metrics aggregation to prevent performance degradation under load

- Add composite indexes (entity_id, is_success) on all metrics tables
  via Alembic migration for efficient aggregation queries
- Add timestamp indexes on all metrics tables for cleanup operations
- Add in-memory metrics cache (MetricsCache) with configurable TTL to
  prevent redundant computation on /metrics and /admin/metrics endpoints
- Replace eager loading of all metric rows (selectinload) with SQL-based
  compute_metrics_summary() classmethods on Tool, Resource, Prompt,
  Server, and A2AAgent models
- Limit get_top_* results in admin metrics endpoint from unbounded
  (limit=None) to limit=10
- Add metrics cleanup infrastructure: cleanup_old_metrics() on all
  service classes with configurable retention via metrics_retention_days
  and metrics_cleanup_enabled settings
- Invalidate metrics cache on metrics reset operations

commits.message:
feat: make metrics cache TTL configurable via METRICS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS

Add metrics_cache_ttl_seconds setting (default: 10, range: 1-300) so
operators can tune the metrics aggregation cache TTL without code
changes. The global MetricsCache singleton reads from settings at
module load time with a fallback to 10 seconds.

commits.message:
test: add unit tests for MetricsCache module

Add 25 tests covering:
- Cache hits and misses for get/set operations
- TTL expiration behavior with time-based assertions
- Independent expiry per key and overwrite resetting TTL
- Single-key and full invalidation
- Statistics tracking (hit/miss counts, hit rate)
- Expired entries counting as misses in stats
- Constructor with default and custom TTL
- Config integration and fallback behavior
